## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: A planned change has a draft PR with proposal, spec deltas, and contracts/...

The system SHALL ensure that a planned change has a draft PR with proposal, spec deltas, and contracts/ before the first implementation commit.

#### Scenario: A planned change has a draft PR with proposal, spec deltas, and contracts/...

WHEN `declare-early-draft-pr` is implemented
THEN A planned change has a draft PR with proposal, spec deltas, and contracts/ before the first implementation commit.

### Requirement: The draft PR body lists contracts introduced or changed and the owners whose...

The system SHALL ensure that the draft PR body lists contracts introduced or changed and the owners whose review is requested, as plain markdown.

#### Scenario: The draft PR body lists contracts introduced or changed and the owners whose...

WHEN `declare-early-draft-pr` is implemented
THEN The draft PR body lists contracts introduced or changed and the owners whose review is requested, as plain markdown.

### Requirement: The behavior is opt-out per repository and is skipped in solo mode unless...

The system SHALL ensure that the behavior is opt-out per repository and is skipped in solo mode unless explicitly enabled.

#### Scenario: The behavior is opt-out per repository and is skipped in solo mode unless...

WHEN `declare-early-draft-pr` is implemented
THEN The behavior is opt-out per repository and is skipped in solo mode unless explicitly enabled.
